rootCause.observed: The old gate searched for the exact step display name 'Bootstrap exact existing Railway customer-proof service'. The failing branch renamed that step to 'Upload exact merged UX source to existing customer-proof service' while keeping RAILWAY_TOKEN step-scoped.
rootCause.mechanism: With set -euo pipefail, grep inside command substitution returned non-zero and terminated the step before the intended scope diagnostic executed.
rootCause.systemicLearning: Security validation must bind to security-significant structure and values, not presentation labels. Gate failures must emit stable machine-readable reasons before exiting.

detection.before: manual Actions-log inspection plus source comparison was required to isolate the silent exit
detection.after: dependency-free validator emits WFM_WORKFLOW_SECURITY:<code>:<message> and reports the structurally scoped secret step

preventionRules: Validate credential scope structurally rather than by workflow step display name.
Require exactly one approved credential reference in each explicitly allowlisted workflow.
Require the credential assignment to be nested under the env block of one named step.
Keep owner-only execution, pinned runner/actions, fixed Railway target IDs, sealed runtime digest and read-only repository permissions fail-closed.
Reject untrusted workflow triggers, unreviewed secret use, mutable action references and public/derivable staging authentication material.
Run positive and negative regression fixtures before repository-wide workflow validation on every owner push.

recovery.reason: No production or customer state was changed; mitigation is isolated on a review branch.

openUncertainty: Latest development candidate 0.6.110 still lacks a completed whole-product regression under an actual supported Node >=22.23.2 runtime.
Genuine provider Level A and independent external assurance remain separate open gates.
